newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay August trade deficit $92.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay August trade deficit $92.9 mln.

text.p: Uruguay ran up a $92.9 million trade deficit in August, up from $28.7 million in August 1995 and down from $108.7 million this July, the Central Bank said Thursday.
Imports rose to $301.0 million in August, from $218.5 million the same month a year before, and $309.8 million in July.
Exports climbed to $208.1 million in August, versus $189.8 million in August 1995 and $201.1 million this July.
In the first eight months of 1996, Uruguay's trade deficit totaled $542.4 million, up from $378.8 million in the same period of 1995.
Between January and August, imports were $2.07 billion, against $1.85 billion in the first eight months of 1995.
Exports were $1.54 billion, compared with $1.47 billion in same period last year.
